Name: Anti Tool Exhaustion
Author: Tomokisan1
Description:
Prevent you to become exhausted from an accidental tool use.

You can configure the number of time per day the mod will "save" you from ﻿exhaustion.

Since 1.0.1 : You can set an infinite "saves" of exhaustion.

Work for any tool : ﻿Axe, Hoe, MilkPail, Pickaxe, Shears and WateringCan.

The mod will restore you the used stamina when you normally exhaust the number of time you configured per day.

Come translated in english and french.
